title: Morphisms out of the sheaf associated to a module
statement:
Let $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], $R=\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X)$, and for an $R$-module $M$ let $\mathcal F_M$, $c_M:M\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal F_M)$ and, for $R$-linear $u$, $\mathcal F_u$ be the associated $\mathcal O_X$-module, its canonical section map and the induced morphism [def-weil-pbc-associated-module]. For every sheaf of $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], regard $\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)$ as an $R$-module. Then the map
$$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal F_M,\mathcal G)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,\Gamma(X,\mathcal G)),\qquad\varphi\longmapsto\varphi_X\circ c_M$$
is bijective. It is natural in $\mathcal G$ and in $M$: for an $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\beta:\mathcal G\to\mathcal G'$ it carries $\beta\circ\varphi$ to $\beta_X\circ(\varphi_X\circ c_M)$, and for an $R$-linear $u:M'\to M$ it carries $\varphi\circ\mathcal F_u$ to $(\varphi_X\circ c_M)\circ u$. (Stacks, Modules, Lemma 01BH, assertion (4), with $\alpha=\mathrm{id}_R$.)

source.place: Modules, Lemma 01BH (lemma-construct-quasi-coherent-sheaves), assertion (4), with alpha = id; proof there by adjointness of pi_* and pi^* (Sheaves, Lemma 0096) for pi : (X, O_X) -> ({*}, R) and the identification of constructions (1) and (3)
